description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) RELENTLESS ASSAULT (Tacticus Firestorm Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). SELECT_SHOOTER on the Hellblaster Squad (TACTICUS) opens unit_selected_to_shoot; the card offers the printed choice ([SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE] / Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE]); a real click on the sustained button spends 1 CP; its attacks against the Flash Gitz (INFANTRY) have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; against a VEHICLE they would not; the Hellblasters then shoot the Flash Gitz.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force
